summary: LONG trades dominate the dataset with a 56% win rate when ADX > 35, indicating trend strength is critical. The strongest pattern is LONG entries with large DI+ > DI- gaps (≥10 points) and ADX > 30, which achieved 100% win rate. Conversely, LONG trades with ADX < 25 failed 75% of the time. Avoid RSI > 65 overbought conditions and extreme sentiment readings; neutral-to-positive sentiment performs best.
